import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double curDif = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        long ansB = 0;
        long ansA = 0;

        for (long b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
            long a1 = (x * b) / y;
            long a2 = a1 + 1;

            double dif1 = Math.abs((double) a1 / b - (double) x / y);
            if (dif1 + 1e-15 < curDif) {
                curDif = dif1;
                ansB = b;
                ansA = a1;
            }

            double dif2 = Math.abs((double) a2 / b - (double) x / y);
            if (dif2 + 1e-15 < curDif) {
                curDif = dif2;
                ansB = b;
                ansA = a2;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ansA + "/" + ansB);
        sc.close();
    }
}
